methodology.label_policy: Gold labels, product outcomes, and manual case-type labels may be used only in validation_shadow fields; they are not ranking inputs.
methodology.purpose: Allocate LLM generation budget to trigger/target pairs where more active, shadow, or phrase/no-winner evidence is most likely to improve semantic-veto quality.
methodology.ranking_scope: Programmatic-feature scan over currently measured/scored candidate rows. It can rank a wider inventory once the same metadata fields are available for that inventory.

next_steps: Run this scanner after every difficulty-stratification refresh.
Use top rows to request LLM active/shadow/phrase evidence packets.
Add a wider inventory input once rulegen can emit the same programmatic metadata for all candidate rules.
Evaluate rank quality with labels only after the priority list is frozen.
